'''Ōkawane-no-Sukune''' (''ōkawato-no-sukune''/''ōkawane-no-sukune''; dates of birth and death unknown) was a {{ill|gōzoku|ja|豪族}} of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}} and the first '''{{ill|Imizu no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|伊彌頭国造}}'''.<ref>Yoshida Yoshihiro manuscript of ''Sendai Kuji Hongi Ten'', held by the {{ill|Tenri Central Library|ja|天理図書館|lt=Tenri Library}}.</ref>

== Overview ==
According to the "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}'', he was a grandson of {{ill|Takeshiuchi no Sukune|ja|建内宿禰|lt=Takeuchi no Sukune|lt_ja=建内宿禰}} and is recorded as a figure of the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ja|成務天皇|lt=Emperor Seimu|lt_ja=成務朝}}.
